Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

KKR & Co.’s non-traded business development company KKR FS Income Trust Select slightly exceeded its quarterly redemption limit to meet all withdrawal requests, according to a shareholder letter.

K-FITS, a private credit fund for retail investors, received repurchase requests for 5.06% of shares for the period ended on Sept. 29, according to a filing Monday. The fund, which has a net asset value of $996 million, will slightly exceed its 5% redemption limit to satisfy all redemption requests.
